note: Reads the page sweep (page-sweep.test.ts) found that a page draws without a stated failure (INV-263). Each is a finding with a status token (standing rule 14) and the slice that owes the fix. The sweep test requires this register to equal the sweep's silent set exactly: a NEW silent read fails the build, and a fixed one fails it until its entry is deleted here, so the register retires itself. Fixing one means the page states the failure beside the part that is missing, with Retry; those additions are design changes owed (docs/DESIGN-CHANGES-OWED.md).
